description.default: Render the signed-in employee's broad cross-family HR summary with key alerts and attention items. Use for prompts such as 'What needs my attention across HR?', 'Show my HR dashboard', or 'Give me my HR summary'. Do not use for profile completeness, ranked next actions, worklife metrics or timeline, or milestones; use GetProfileHealth, GetNextBestActions, GetWorklifeSnapshot, or GetEmployeeMilestones. Pass period, focusArea, locale, privacyLevel, or includeSensitive only when explicit.
